notes.title: SenS update - v0.007
notes.content:
SenS update
version 0.007
2023/03/02


Light consciousness exploration: Light creates The Structure, darkness sends you into the Nothingness.

This update introduce the new unified Structure exploration system, allowing players to visualize and explore the material and abstract structures. 
Reshape the world architecture by materializing new places: unlock access to these places by exploring the abstract structure and using the Light Elements.
Explores the discovered areas to improve capacities, get new ones, and get access to new abstract structure elements, allowing for further exploration...


-New unified Structure exploration system.
-New playable entity: "Light consciousness".
-Light Element creation system.
-New HUD, featuring an abstract structure map and an history.


Keep in mind this is still prototyping phase, what you can play now doesn't reflect the quality and content to be in the final game.
Feedback and comments are welcome on the game's forum and will help improving the game.

notes.title: SenS update - v0.006
notes.content:
SenS update
version 0.006
2022/12/05

-DevLog-002: Unstable Zones added
Discover the "Unstable Zones", a new gameplay feature explained in this Devlog, including demonstration examples scenes and development history.

-Simplified the body stances controls: Removed "Bent" stance; Now just pressing the button allows to go "Crouch" then back to "Stand"; Holding the button allows to go "Prone" then back to "Stand".

-In main menu, added possibility to start game directly in the "WIP" level to play exploration and experimentation prototype sections.

-"WIP" level graphical improvements.

notes.title: SenS minor update - v0.005
notes.content:
SenS minor update
version 0.005
2022/06/13

-New feature/bug fix(maybe): Priority sorting system for STE's "function components", allowing to determine the order at which functions are executed. Possibly fixes the "Yellow screen of death" issue some people are experiencing. This issue seems to be caused by too slow hard drive and/or too low specs computer as far as I can deduct based on the concerned players feedback. I can't reproduce it, so it's only a deduction. Will see if this update fix it, if not this new feature is a good addition and will be useful anyways.

notes.title: SenS minor update
notes.content:
SenS minor update
version 0.003

-Attempts to fix issues: stuck after exiting "The Empty Room"; "Yellow screen of death"; black screen at the game end instead of going back to main menu.
"Attempts" as I wasn't able to reproduce the issues but made some adjustments possibly fixing the bugs.

-Disabled Steam VR plugin in UE, as it was automatically launching Steam VR while not used by the game now.

-Slightly adjusted the timing for interactible texts where it has no impact on desired flow pace.

-Typo fix.

-Slightly increased texts outlines opacity for better readability in brightfull environments.
